title: Quiz: For Loops
description: Check your understanding of For Loops.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Bash?
questions.explanation: In Bash, # marks a comment. Block comments use # (line comments only).

questions.question: A for loop is best when...
options: you know how many times to repeat
the condition depends on user input forever
questions.correctAnswer: you know how many times to repeat
questions.explanation: For loops count through a known sequence.

questions.question: True or False: Loop counters usually start at 1 in every programming language.
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: $for ... { repeat }
questions.explanation: The for keyword begins a counted loop.

questions.question: In Bash, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
